app.title: The Folders Programming Language
app.author: gurst
app.description: A minimal esoteric programming language that uses nested folders as its primary data structure and execution flow.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and install the interpreter via pip.
Run the provided hello‑world program and verify the expected output.
Create a small program that manipulates a nested folder structure and ensure it executes without errors.
Benchmark the interpreter’s execution time on a 100‑line program and compare to a baseline esolang interpreter.
Verify that the compiler, if present, produces a binary that runs the same program with similar output.
